item.title: Kubernetes Ingress Nginx is retiring
item.description:
📝 Existing deployments of Ingress NGINX will continue to function and installation artifacts will remain available. In March 2026, Ingress NGINX maintenance will be halted, and the project will be retired. Existing deployments of Ingress NGINX will not be broken.
